create_randomized_search_cv: create a RandomizedSearchCV instance to optimize SGDClassifier hyperparameters using random sampling from parameter distributions
create_grid_search_cv: create a GridSearchCV instance to exhaustively search over all combinations of SGDClassifier hyperparameter grid values
run_randomized_search_fit: run randomized search fit on digit classification data to find best hyperparameter settings
run_grid_search_fit: run grid search fit on digit classification data to evaluate all parameter combinations
build_report_results_function: build a report function that prints top-ranked model results including mean validation score, standard deviation, and parameter settings
